017package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.filter;
018
019/**
020 * The outcome of {@link RequestBoundary#check(jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest)}: either allowed, or a
021 * rejection carrying the reason, the HTTP status to answer with, and a message safe to return to the caller.
022 *
023 * <h5 class='section'>See Also:</h5><ul>
024 *    <li class='jc'>{@link BoundaryReason}
025 *    <li class='jc'>{@link RequestBoundaryFilter}
026 * </ul>
027 *
028 * @since 10.0.0
029 */
030public final class BoundaryResult {
031
032   /** The outcome of a request that passed every applicable check. */
033   public static final BoundaryResult ALLOWED = new BoundaryResult(null, 0, null);
034
035   private final BoundaryReason reason;
036   private final int status;
037   private final String message;
038
039   BoundaryResult(BoundaryReason reason, int status, String message) {
040      this.reason = reason;
041      this.status = status;
042      this.message = message;
043   }
044
045   /**
046    * Whether the request passed.
047    *
048    * @return <jk>true</jk> if the request may proceed.
049    */
050   public boolean isAllowed() { return reason == null; }
051
052   /**
053    * Why the request was rejected.
054    *
055    * @return The rejection reason, or <jk>null</jk> when {@link #isAllowed()} is <jk>true</jk>.
056    */
057   public BoundaryReason reason() { return reason; }
058
059   /**
060    * The HTTP status to answer a rejected request with.
061    *
062    * @return The status code, or {@code 0} when {@link #isAllowed()} is <jk>true</jk>.
063    */
064   public int status() { return status; }
065
066   /**
067    * A message describing the rejection.
068    *
069    * <p>
070    * Names the header at fault and what was expected of it.  It never echoes a value the request presented, and never
071    * reveals the expected CSRF token.
072    *
073    * @return The message, or <jk>null</jk> when {@link #isAllowed()} is <jk>true</jk>.
074    */
075   public String message() { return message; }
076
077   @Override /* Object */
078   public String toString() { return isAllowed() ? "ALLOWED" : reason + "(" + status + "): " + message; }
079}
